thread:
Nova: Heads up 11 compact playground on mobile: token badge jitters when streaming, stop/regenerate chip gets obscured by quick-actions, and picking a prompt sometimes restarts the stream. Quick screencap: https://files.internal/s/compact-jitter.mp4
Eli: Saw that. Repro on narrow widths (320px). The token badge moves left-right as digits update.
Sam: Quick fixes: render token in a monospace font + min-width to reserve space (e.g., min-width: 5ch). Also throttle visual updates so we don't reflow on every partial chunk.
Tess: UX preference: floating circular stop overlay (44px touch target) pinned top-right of the message frame; hide it when idle. Must have visible focus ring and be reachable by keyboard. Suggest Esc stops stream too.
Ada: Prompt library insert currently rehydrates the composer 11 kills the websocket. Implement insertText API to patch the DOM and preserve the stream session id. If a rehydrate is unavoidable, snapshot session and resume without a fresh generation call.
Sam: Throttle idea: update token UI at most every 120150ms or batch via requestAnimationFrame. That smooths UX without visible lag.
Tess: A11y: visible icon-only is fine, but aria-label="Stop generation" and aria-label="Regenerate response" for regen. For streaming text use aria-live="polite" and add a "Read latest" control that will assertively announce the most recent chunk on demand.
Eli: CSS snippet for token reserve: ` .token-badge { font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace; min-width: 5ch; text-align: right; } `
Nova: Plan: 1) Sam adds min-width + throttling, 2) Ada implements insertText + session-preserve, 3) Tess mock floating stop + keyboard flow, 4) ui-bot preview and a11y checklist. Pairing: Tess+Nova on visuals at 14:00, Ada+Sam on continuity at 15:00.
ui-bot: Preview: https://playground.internal/preview/compact-222999 (mobile emulation + visual diffs).
Nova: Thanks all 11 will track actions on the design board and run a small beta after PRs land.
